era: Seventh-generation cult action and modern remaster
summary: Grasshopper Manufacture's Suda51/Shinji Mikami horror-action collaboration, remastered as Hella Remastered.

entries.title: Shadows of the Damned
entries.definitive_edition: Shadows of the Damned: Hella Remastered on Windows

emulation.notes: Use Hella Remastered on PC rather than emulating the original console releases.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows Hella Remastered at highest stable settings

primary.version: Shadows of the Damned: Hella Remastered
primary.why: The original Shadows of the Damned released on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 in 2011. Hella Remastered brought it to Switch, PlayStation, Xbox, and Windows in 2024, making Windows the highest-fidelity and most flexible route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Hella Remastered on Windows at the highest stable settings; use PS5 or Xbox Series X/S as strong console alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: Hella Remastered is the modern route; use PS3/Xbox 360 only for original-release preservation.
